title: ABBA Universal Knowledge Mastery Fabric
principle: Knowledge is decomposed into attributable atoms and capabilities; mastery is progressively assessed and externally verified.
rules: A knowledge atom is not automatically true because ABBA generated it.
Source provenance, evidence, interpretation and conclusion remain distinct.
A language capability may include words, senses, grammar, scripts, modality, usage, idiom, slang and cultural context.
Files, folders, repositories and branches are knowledge objects with provenance and lineage; location is not truth.
External verification must remain distinct from ABBA self-assessment.
Emeritus is a mastery/reassessment state, not an authority grant.
Superseded or stale knowledge remains reconstructable and is not silently deleted.
Contradictory sources remain represented as conflicts until resolved or explicitly marked unresolved.
authorityBoundary: Knowledge acquisition and mastery update never grant authority or permission to act.
